conbody.p: Emergency Stop will release when the following conditions are satisfied.

li.p: The driver focuses on the road ahead (if equipped) and controls the steering wheel
If the accelerator pedal is strongly engaged and maintained
If the brake pedal is strongly engaged
If the Lane Following Assist button () is pressed
If the Driver Assistance button is pressed
Hazard warning flasher button is pressed after the vehicle stops.
The front seat door (driver or front passenger) is opened.
The driver cancels an SOS call (if the function is provided).
Shifting from P (Park) to another gear.

note.p: After the vehicle comes to a stop due to an Emergency Stop, to activate Lane Following Assist or Highway Driving Assist, the vehicle needs to be restarted.
